name: Podcast episodes
summary: A show's episode list: date and length, a two-line description, a play button that shows how much is left of a half-played episode, a played mark, and a download button that goes from download to a progress ring to done.
use: on a podcast or audio-course show page
a11y: Each episode is a list item with its title as a heading; play names the episode and the time left, and the download button says its state (download, downloading with the percent, downloaded) in its name.

use_when: a list of recorded talks or lessons people play in order and keep offline
avoid_when: songs in an album or playlist: use track-list
playing the current episode with controls: use music-player
videos or shows with poster art: use media-shelf or title-detail

parts.name: kicker
parts.what: the kind of show and how often it comes out

parts.name: count
parts.what: how many episodes and the order

parts.name: meta
parts.what: a New tag, the date and the length

parts.name: description
parts.what: what the episode is about, cut to two lines

parts.name: play
parts.what: play or pause, with the length or a bar and the time left

parts.name: played
parts.what: a tick and 'Played' for finished episodes

parts.name: download
parts.what: download, a progress ring while downloading, then a done tick

empty.how: for a show with no episodes yet, keep the header and use empty-state under it with 'First episode coming soon'

loading.how: keep the header and show three rows with grey bars for the date, title and two description lines; the download ring is for downloads only

error.how: if a download fails, put the button back to download and show toast-stack with 'Download failed'

disabled.how: when offline, set disabled on download for episodes not yet saved and dim them

overflow.how: the list grows with every episode; show about ten and add pagination or a Show more button

long_text.how: descriptions are cut to two lines; titles and the show name wrap

keyboard: Tab moves through each episode's play, download and more buttons in order
Enter or Space on play starts that episode and pauses any other; again pauses it
Enter or Space on download starts it, and on a downloading or downloaded episode cancels or removes it
